node: Data-center electrical and thermal balance-of-plant: switchgear, transformers, busway, UPS, power distribution, cooling distribution units, cold plates, and monitoring
summary: Expanded the universe for the data-center electrical and thermal balance-of-plant node using a two-lane funnel. Vertiv is retained as the high-attention reference anchor because its public disclosures directly map to busway, UPS, CDU, liquid cooling and monitoring. The underfollowed lane emphasizes smaller or less AI-labeled suppliers with evidence of data-center demand: Powell Industries for medium-voltage electrical distribution and switchgear-like systems; EnerSys for UPS and short-duration backup batteries; and Bel Fuse for rack-level power conversion, protection, connectivity and high-speed interconnect. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. Key falsification checks are customer concentration, order lumpiness, whether data-center mix is material versus incidental, and whether margins normalize as capacity catches up.
